listing.name: Rise of the Concordact Navy
listing.summary: Adds the Concordact, a powerful minor polity with a presence in the northwestern Core Worlds, past League space.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Concordact, a minor polity with modified midline and high-tech ships that favor extended engagements.

description:
"Don the obsidian and white. Preserve the Sector."

Adds the Concordact, a powerful minor polity with a presence in the northwestern Core Worlds, past League space. Distinguished by the monochrome liveries of their fleet of modified midline and high tech ships, Concordact doctrine favours extended engagements, outlasting the enemy before overrunning them when they falter.

The Ships

There may also be a few other things out there to find...good hunting. ;)

Requires MagicLib, LazyLib, GraphicsLib and Nexerelin.

(Not compatible with existing saves! A new save will be required to experience this mod.)

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BDhCuEFwSuvBVYVZC4C507B8jVw4EoaR/view?usp=sharing

Changelog
0.3.0 (new save required)
- Added four new Concordact Navy ships: The Henki (CN), Bathory (CN) (courtesy of Amazigh's Ship Foundry, go check it out!), Victory (CN) and Vulture (CN) (thank you Dark.Revenant and Gwyvern for permission!)
- Added three new auxiliary ships: Dram (CN), Phaeton (CN), and Prometheus (CN) (both these and the existing Atlas (CN) and Buffalo (CN) have been recategorised under the 'Concordact Auxiliary'.)
- Removed Odyssey (CN) and Sunder (CN): Didn't feel like they fit the lineup anymore. But don't worry! If you did like them, they'll be returning in a bonus pack down the line.
- Updated star systems: Aegeir is looking fresher and there's been some minor improvements across the board.
Recategorised the Radiant (CN): now acquired via the Lazarus Site, no longer spawns in Concordact fleets
- Added Scintilla (LD): acquired via the Lazarus Site
- Added new [VERY REDACTED] weapons: acquired via the Lazarus Site
- Updated sprites for [VERY REDACTED] ships for sale at the Lazarus Site
- General bug fixes

- (Emergent Threats Pack) Added Torchbearer (CN)

0.2.0 (don't ask about 0.1.0)
- Initial mod release

Concordact Navy - Emergent Threats

A submod for Rise of the Concordact Navy, adding a few extra ships fielded by the Concordact in their war with the IX Battlegroup. Requires Emergent Threats and IX Revival.

There's also interaction with IX Revival even without this submod! Find Gregory Wakefield and have a chat with him about the major threats of the Sector.

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TSQlnQbRB9q4WugmlMybsJAqJ3kVPWa_/view?usp=sharing

The Ships

Credits to:
Fellout - Gorget
BinBin - Cuttlefish, Scrimshaw
Tariflette - Nova (Sublimity), Owl sprite used as a base for the Nightjar
Amazigh - Bathory, Henki, Cusp, and Remnant fighter sprites used for kitbashing the Luxion and Glitter
Spiral Arms - Falconer base sprite
Gwyvern, Shellster - Vulture (CN) base sprite
Vicegrip - ET/IX assets
Selkie - Victory (CN) base sprite
Joebob - Warhawk (CN) base sprite

(No AI has been used in any area of this project! If there is AI content anywhere, I didn't put it there, and please let me know so I can get rid of it.)
